summary: If you have public examples and allowed to share be great to add to https://indieweb.org/Education Been trying to convince @edublogs folks to add SemPress theme and IndieWeb plugins. So many people want the IndieWeb toys on @edublogs Still we should collaborate. Stay in touch

body_html:
If you have public examples and allowed to share be great to add to https://indieweb.org/Education

So many people want the IndieWeb toys on @edublogs

Still we should collaborate. Stay in touch
